description: SYNTHETIC: ticket triage into a JSON array with enum labels; lenient parsing (a ```json fence is accepted).

messages.content:
Classify each ticket. Return a JSON array in the same order as the tickets, one object per ticket with keys id, label (one of bug, billing, feature_request, other) and priority (one of low, medium, high).
